rationale: Tests epidemiological understanding of childhood TB burden and risk factors including malnutrition and contact history
Tests knowledge of pulmonary TB presentation and paucibacillary nature in children
Tests accurate Mantoux interpretation thresholds including the lower cut-off for immunocompromised children
Tests knowledge of CBNAAT utility and its simultaneous detection of rifampicin resistance
Tests critical knowledge that NTEP uses daily FDC dosing, not the older thrice-weekly RNTCP regimen
Tests knowledge of Isoniazid Preventive Therapy eligibility criteria for child contacts under 5 years
Tests clinical approach to fever in children including identification of danger signs and fever definition
Tests contraindication of aspirin in febrile children with dengue or chickenpox due to Reye syndrome risk
Tests knowledge of Koplik spots as pathognomonic early sign of measles before the rash appears
Tests vitamin A supplementation in measles management as a proven mortality-reducing intervention in India
Tests clinical differentiation of diphtheria from other causes of acute upper airway obstruction based on the pseudomembrane characteristics
Tests that TIG (tetanus immunoglobulin) not equine antitoxin is used for wound prophylaxis in tetanus
Tests unreliability of Widal test versus blood culture as gold standard for typhoid diagnosis
Tests knowledge of when intestinal perforation occurs in typhoid and recognition of its clinical signs
Tests differentiation of dengue warning signs from malaria and chikungunya presentations during monsoon season
Tests correct malaria treatment: ACT for falciparum vs chloroquine plus primaquine for vivax, with G6PD check before primaquine
Tests National Deworming Day programme and albendazole as the drug used for soil-transmitted helminths
Tests clinical differentiation of giardiasis from amoebiasis and correct treatment for each
